SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   B. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal skills.

   D. Say Diversity and interpersonal skills never happens in Kenya.
